result.topic_en: A heavily corrected prose draft for the introduction of Riemann's dissertation. It argues that extending dependence laws between variable quantities to imaginary values reveals hidden harmony and regularity, as in the theory of algebraic, circular, exponential, elliptic and Abelian functions. It also notes that earlier methods based their investigation of such functions on a particular expression of them (mode of determination and quantity operations).
